# Does the European Accessibility Act apply to your product or service?

> Free European Accessibility Act checker: pick what you make or sell, your role and your size to see whether Directive (EU) 2019/882 likely applies, whether the microenterprise exemption covers you, and the main duties. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
